factual_errors.text: It wastes 25% to heat, sound or other stores we don't want.
factual_errors.correction: Sound is not an energy store. It is a way energy is transferred, and the energy carried by sound ends up in the thermal store of the surroundings. 'Heat' is also better described as energy transferred to the thermal store of the surroundings, where it is dissipated.
